scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_CORE --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_RUNS --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_CORE --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_RUNS --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_CORE --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_RUNS --remote
scripts.teardown: wrangler delete && wrangler d1 delete flaretown-core && wrangler d1 delete flaretown-runs && wrangler r2 bucket delete flaretown-artifacts && echo 'Also delete the agent repos in Cloudflare Artifacts (agent-*), the sandbox container apps and images (pnpm wrangler containers list / delete, pnpm wrangler containers images list / delete), and agents/*/browser-profile.tar.gz in R2'
